objective: Make detached audit manifests independent of checkout line-ending filters while retaining clean-worktree and exact-candidate checks.

repair.manifest_source: HEAD tree entries and immutable Git blob objects, with ordinary 100644/100755 blobs only
repair.fail_closed: Malformed tree records, duplicate or non-UTF-8 paths, backslash paths, absolute paths, dot segments, empty path components, non-regular modes, non-blob entries, malformed object ids, and unavailable blobs raise AUDIT_MANIFEST_INVALID.
repair.toctou: Verification enumerates candidate.revision and rechecks repository identity, clean status, HEAD, and HEAD tree after manifest generation.
repair.preserved_checks: Receipt, trust fingerprint, exact candidate, validation artifact, and detached signature checks remain unchanged.

regressions: A new regression materializes one commit with LF and CRLF checkout settings, proves the working bytes differ, and proves committed-byte manifests match.
A new regression proves a HEAD change during manifest generation is rejected.
A new parameterized regression proves symlink, submodule, malformed tree metadata, and malformed object id entries fail closed.
A second repair regression proves ../escape, /absolute, ./alias, a//b, and a/../b paths fail closed.
Existing focused tests cover valid receipts, altered and incomplete manifests, dirty worktrees, wrong HEAD/tree, trust failures, validation failures, and pending slice binding.

validation.command: uv run --with pytest --with cryptography pytest -q tests/test_audit_receipts.py tests/test_slice_contexts.py
uv run ruff format src/forge/audit_receipts.py tests/test_audit_receipts.py
uv run ruff check src/forge/audit_receipts.py tests/test_audit_receipts.py

migration_impact: No migration performed. The existing rejected external receipt and signature remain untouched outside the repository.
remaining_unknowns: No candidate SHA exists until Sol freezes and commits the bounded worktree.
The full scripts/validate.sh gate, detached signature, and two-checkout independent verification remain for Sol after candidate freeze.
No graph status, trust record, historical receipt, key, provider, remote, merge, or deployment state was changed.
not_done: No commit, push, merge, signing, deployment, model call, spend, or graph update.
No self-certification or independent audit verdict.
